metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 1931 · M
metas.description: When the police in a German city are unable to catch a child-murderer, other criminals join in the manhunt.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1923 · Safety Last!
metas.description: A boy leaves his small country town and heads to the big city to get a job. As soon as he makes it big his sweetheart will join him and marry him. His enthusiasm to get ahead leads to some interesting adventures.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1920 · The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
metas.description: Hypnotist Dr. Caligari uses a somnambulist, Cesare, to commit murders.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1945 · Rome, Open City
metas.description: During the Nazi occupation of Rome in 1944, the Resistance leader, Giorgio Manfredi, is chased by the Nazis as he seeks refuge and a way to escape.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1944 · Arsenic and Old Lace
metas.description: Mortimer Brewster, a Brooklyn writer of books on the futility of marriage, risks his reputation after he decides to tie the knot. Things grow complicated when he learns that his beloved maiden aunts Abby and Martha are serial murd...

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1925 · Battleship Potemkin
metas.description: In the midst of the Russian Revolution of 1905, the crew of the battleship Potemkin mutiny against the brutal, tyrannical regime of the vessel's officers. The resulting street demonstration in Odessa brings on a police massacre.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1943 · Shadow of a Doubt
metas.description: A teenage girl, overjoyed when her uncle comes to visit the family in their quiet California town, slowly begins to suspect that he is the "Merry Widow" killer sought by the authorities.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1935 · The 39 Steps
metas.description: A man in London tries to help a counter-espionage agent, but when the agent is killed and the man stands accused, he must go on the run to save himself and stop a spy ring that is trying to steal top-secret information.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1942 · Cat People
metas.description: An American man marries a Serbian immigrant who fears that she will turn into the cat person of her homeland's fables if they are intimate together.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1942 · Saboteur
metas.description: A young man accused of sabotage goes on the run to prove his innocence.
